Anticoagulation: In patients on NOACs, regardless of timing of last administration, add low-dose parenteral anticoagulation (e.g. enoxaparin 0.5 mg/kg i.v. or UFH 60 IU/kg).
Anticoagulant doses adjusted to body weight and renal function, especially in women and older patients.
In patients on VKAs, do not administer UFH if INR >2.5.
PCI performed without interruption of VKAs or NOACs.
Antiplatelet_therapy: Aspirin is indicated but avoid pre-treatment with P2Y12 receptor inhibitors.
GP IIb/IIIa receptor inhibitors only for bailout or peri-procedural complications.

content.Gastrointestinal_protection: Proton pump inhibitors in patients on dual antiplatelet therapy at higher-than-average risk of gastrointestinal bleeds (history of GI ulcer/haemorrhage, anticoagulant therapy, chronic NSAID/corticosteroid use) or two or more risk factors.
